### Blocker 1 — Z3: C-0380 (2)'s "the read refuses as before" is unpinned (CONFIRMED)

The tree (kerb.ts:289) adds no vertex-only spine where the edge spines' kerb `base` refuses, so the read returns
that refusal. Z3 (`: []` → `: vertexOnly`) adds them; the one overlay refuses again, and the staged read then runs on
`staged.base = []` (kerb.ts:293), so `lessParts` returns `ok([])` — an EMPTY kerb, and `clearOf([])` accepts it.
The families reach this path — this seat's census found 4 refused faces with a vertex-only chain of declared width
(`zz-c6refused`, 87 refused faces in all):

| input (LAWFUL) | tree | Z3 |

| refusals.json rows 142 / 143 (one network), face 1 | kerb E_INVARIANT `insert: no route from (403, -119) to (0, 323) …`; corridorUnion the same | kerb `ok([])` (0 rings); corridorUnion still refuses (face 4, the same message) |
| B-FUZZ seed 20261011 draw 1000 `[{a 13701, b 8004, hw 366, knots [71, 13]}, {a 10997, b 7981, hw 27, knots [432, 490], square}, {a 7687, b 8005, hw 419}]`, face 1 | kerb and corridorUnion E_INVARIANT `insert: no route from (3581, 4000) to (3581, 3687) …`, nothing written | kerb `ok([])`; **corridorUnion COMMITS, face 1 `wholeBand`** (blocks 1) |
| B-FUZZ seed 20261011 draw 4776 `[{a 15998, b 8039, hw 194, knots [6, 138], square}, {a 15994, b 7978, hw 1, knots [563, 528]}, {a 14167, b 6, hw 8, knots [26, 170]}]`, face 0 | kerb and corridorUnion E_INVARIANT `insert: no route from (170, 0) to (0, 1833) …` | kerb `ok([])`; **corridorUnion COMMITS, faces 0, 1 `wholeBand`** |
